task.title: Persist the latest due recurrence occurrence atomically
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/917 by selecting and persisting one exact recurrence's latest due authored coordinate in one guarded operation.
acceptance_criteria: Validate the observed immutable definition revision and reuse constant-space latest-due selection through the caller cutoff.
Atomically recheck prerequisites and selected stream absence before appending exactly one canonical occurrence event.
Write nothing for future horizons and fail closed on stale definitions, duplicates, selected corruption, storage errors, or competing writers.

attempts.summary: Established RED behavior and concurrency coverage.
attempts.diagnostic: Kernel integration tests failed because persist_latest_due_occurrence did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added tests for durability, future write-free results, revision mismatch, maximum offsets, skipped-corruption isolation, duplicates, and racing writers before implementation.

attempts.diagnostic: Added revision validation, shared latest-due projection, duplicate detection, and transactional conflict handling so only one competing writer can commit.
attempts.patch: Implemented persist_latest_due_occurrence and a private projection helper shared by read-only and writable paths; documented the contract in ADR-0062.

attempts.summary: Completed exact-head review without racing the rate limit.
attempts.diagnostic: The automatic CodeRabbit run was rate limited and treated as false-green evidence. After cooldown, a genuine review completed with no actionable comments, zero review threads, and the exact head passed the Rust quality gate.
attempts.patch: Retained one atomic provenance boundary and reran focused recurrence tests, all recurrence-store tests, and the complete repository gate.

outcome.summary: The kernel atomically proves one caller-selected latest-due coordinate without persisting skipped work, a continuation cursor, or any materialization or execution grant.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo run --locked -p vela-dev -- record validate corpus/development/0188-atomic-latest-due-recurrence-persistence.json # result: valid development record
nix develop --command cargo run --locked -p vela-dev -- corpus inspect corpus/development # result: inspected 193 records: 193 valid, 0 invalid
Pull request 918 exact head a5a607ecc41bb47868fee16215f1ce40747d3a63 squash merge 9d7b276e50bfe12b0ca17ecc5af187400b545fb1

lessons: Selection and append must share one guarded transaction to remove the race between separate read and write calls.
Persisting one selected coordinate does not accept, waive, inspect, or persist skipped coordinates.
A continuation cursor remains transient caller guidance rather than durable lifecycle evidence.
Atomic provenance persistence grants no task identity, materialization, dispatch, retry, permission, or execution authority.
A rate-limited review status must not arm merge even when other checks are green.
